choice_data_list: Looks like you got plenty of rest.
Looks like you got plenty of rest, huh?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I stretch before bed, drink hot milk, and 
play audiobooks of chivalric tales from my 
phone by the pillow to ensure a natural 
sleep!
choice_data_list: It's amazing that you're so thorough!
It's amazing that you're so thorough!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal seems to have gotten an ideal 
amount of rest!"
